name: company_lookup
description: Check a national company register: does this company exist, is it active and in good standing. EUR 0.01 when found (100 free per account), a miss is free.

arguments.name: country
arguments.desc: ISO country code of the register (required)

arguments.name: company_name
arguments.desc: Company name; give this or registration_number

arguments.name: registration_number
arguments.desc: Registration number, matched exactly

arguments.name: state
arguments.desc: US state code, required for US registers

arguments.name: include
arguments.desc: Optional extras for the found company: officers, filings

name: company_officers
description: List a company's officers (directors, secretaries, board members) from its register, current and former. EUR 0.01 when found.

arguments.name: country
arguments.desc: ISO country code of the register

arguments.name: registration_number
arguments.desc: Company registration number

name: kyb_findings
description: Screen a company for KYB risk: company register, owners, sanctions and PEP matches, ICIJ Offshore Leaks records and adverse media, each finding naming its kind of source. EUR 0.50.

arguments.name: company_name
arguments.desc: Company name (required)

arguments.name: website
arguments.desc: Company website, optional but recommended: it separates the company from unrelated ones sharing the name

arguments.name: country
arguments.desc: ISO country code; without it no company register is searched

arguments.name: registration_number
arguments.desc: Company registration number (optional)

arguments.name: state
arguments.desc: US state code, required for US companies

arguments.name: vat_number
arguments.desc: VAT number (optional)

name: kyb_run_submit
description: Order a full written KYB due-diligence report (async); returns a run_id for check_report_status. EUR 6.00.

arguments.name: company_name
arguments.desc: Company name (required)

arguments.name: website
arguments.desc: Company website, optional but recommended: it separates the company from unrelated ones sharing the name

arguments.name: country
arguments.desc: ISO country code; without it no company register is searched

arguments.name: registration_number
arguments.desc: Company registration number (optional)

arguments.name: state
arguments.desc: US state code, required for US companies

arguments.name: vat_number
arguments.desc: VAT number (optional)

name: adverse_media
description: Screen a company for negative news, complaints and bad reviews. EUR 0.50.

arguments.name: company_name
arguments.desc: Company name (required)

arguments.name: website
arguments.desc: Company website, optional but recommended: it separates the company from unrelated ones sharing the name

name: check_report_status
description: Poll the status of an async report submitted via kyb_run_submit. Free.

arguments.name: run_id
arguments.desc: The run_id returned by kyb_run_submit

arguments.name: agent_type
arguments.desc: kyb-diligence (default) or adverse-media

name: account_balance
description: Check the prepaid balance, the free trial call and the free company lookups left. Free.
